rigveda.summary: The oldest surviving Sanskrit text and the foundational Vedic scripture, transmitted orally with extraordinary fidelity for millennia before being written down.
rigveda.note: Most philologists place the core hymns c. 1500–1200 BCE on linguistic grounds; some Indian scholars argue for substantially earlier dates tied to the Sarasvati river and Indus continuity. No manuscript evidence survives from the period, so all dates are inferential.
